scope: Pin only. No password task, UI styling, radio occupancy, router command or session-directory changes.
compatibility_scope: These incremental changes affect local reporting and checkpoint result references only; no new OpenWrt command, firmware or driver contract is introduced. Existing Pixie Dust command path was inspected and exercised offline, not certified across routers.
configuration_findings: Previous advanced dialog accepted spoof_mac_enabled=true with an empty address; the settings manager preserves the two values independently.
Quick and advanced entries share wps_defaults. No evidence found that load/save clears a valid source address.
The exact historical action that enabled spoofing is unknown. Existing invalid configuration is reported, not silently rewritten.
incremental_fixes: Mode-specific service start message for Pixie Dust.
PIN-only results retain and display termination reason without exposing recovered credentials.
Retain last successful checkpoint reference when final redundant download fails.
preserved: Disabled spoofing accepts an empty address.
Enabled empty address prompts once before task/interface allocation.
Valid source reaches the real command builder; remote process start is mocked.
No automatic import from legacy result directories.
manual_acceptance: Disable spoofing or enter a valid source address in advanced Pin; confirm and reopen to verify persistence.
On an authorized router, run one selected target with quick Pin; verify remote Reaver startup, target status and explicit end reason.
Verify cancellation cleanup and the next run resumes only from RouterManagerData/wps-sessions.
reference_read: https://github.com/wiire-a/pixiewps (upstream description only; not an installed-version compatibility claim)
